title: [spec-gap][R-BB-004] Python runtime ACK/NACK TX-queue deadline 5000ms diverges from spec 10s and shared vectors
description: spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md:77 ACK/NACK deadline = 10 s. Oracle: test/vectors/tx_queue_expiry.json constants DEADLINE_ACK_MS=10000 + bufferbloat_congestion.json deadline_expiry ack_deadline_ms=10000. C conforms (TX_DEADLINE_ACK_MS=10000, lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h:73); Rust conforms (DEADLINE_ACK_MS=10_000, rust/lichen-core/src/tx_queue.rs:253). DIVERGENT: Python runtime python/src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py:39 DEADLINE_ACK_MS = 5000 ('alias for ROUTING'); runtime node (node.py:72) imports from lichen.link.tx_queue. Confusing second module python/src/lichen/timing/tx_queue.py:28 has the correct 10000 and is what vector tests drive (python/tests/timing/test_tx_queue_vectors.py), while tests/timing exercises a module the runtime never imports. Suggested placement: set link/tx_queue.py DEADLINE_ACK_MS=10000 (keep Priority.ACK is Priority.ROUTING), then reconcile or delete the duplicate lichen/timing/tx_queue.py so only one Python TX queue exists; rust/lichen-core tests/bufferbloat_vectors.rs:54 and python timing vector tests already pin 10000 so no test changes needed.
